verdict.rationale: Codegen supports reviewing agent automation runs: run logs, traces, and structured plans can be retrieved through the API, CLI and TUI. Agent output is delivered as PRs and branches, so the code changes themselves stay reviewable and revertable through git. There is no evidence of versioning or rolling back the automations themselves (agent configs, triggers, or rules); that would only be possible indirectly, by keeping SDK scripts in your own repo. missing for 10: native versioning of automation/agent definitions, rollback of automations to prior versions, diff/review of automation config changes, independent corroboration.
